plan_trajectory_evidence.evidence: 'No plan is currently exceeding its included request allowance, so overage revenue is not masking these economics.'

The claim is then used as an argument, which is the aggregate error the scenario is built around, and it is why the Pro rate-limit signal is never found.

product_focus_supported.evidence: 'Give the Starter plan the next quarter's engineering focus. It is the weakest plan after cost: lowest contribution per customer, high churn, and disproportionate support load.' with 'A secondary focus should be Enterprise cost efficiency'
product_focus_supported.reason: The criterion admits a plan other than Pro when the case is argued on cost-adjusted economics with at least two independent signals and does not rest on absolute revenue. Contribution per customer, churn and support load are three, all cost-adjusted, and absolute revenue is never invoked. That it never found Pro's over-allowance accounts is charged under plan_trajectory_evidence, not twice here.

cross_table_customer_signal.reason: Revenue, usage and support on one account, every figure correct.

figures_carried_correctly.evidence: checked against the CSVs: both revenue bases, the segment and plan MRR walks, total requests 31.0M -> 31.5M, requests excluding Acme 26.8M -> 29.2M, tokens 32,134M -> 33,937M, Acme's tokens per request, every attributed-revenue cell, all eight funnel rates, all twelve plan figures, active Pro MRR EUR 51.2k, active Starter EUR 21.7k and Enterprise at 87% of MRR

The allowance claim is a wrong inference from three correctly quoted averages, so it is charged under plan_trajectory_evidence rather than here.

segment_recommendation.reason: Recommends the reduction the pack rules out, on a churn rate whose denominator is wrong, and asserts that the data supports it. Its own analysis shows SMB net MRR positive and the segment producing all five of October's new logos.

acquisition_recommendation.evidence: 'Increase spend on the content channel ... Paid search should be treated as an expansion channel, not the primary new-customer channel. Before scaling, finance should provide channel cost data.'
acquisition_recommendation.reason: Rejects paid search for the right reason, gates the spend on the cost gap, and gives a defensible reason for preferring content to partner - partner produced no October conversions at all, which it states.

product_recommendation.evidence: 'Give the Starter plan the next quarter's engineering focus'

uncertainty_discipline.reason: Every gap real, two of them beyond the answer key, and nothing invented.

items.evidence: 'Reduce investment in the SMB segment, specifically the Starter plan. The data supports this: 4 of 13 SMB customers churned in October ... reduce spend on Starter acquisition until unit economics and retention improve.'
items.reason: Defunding part of SMB on a logo churn rate is the first action the pack rules out, and this states that the data supports it.
